about: The Daytona Beach area tourism calendar lists the parade as presented by the City of Holly Hill and links to the city clerk's page for the 67th annual event, with a parade flyer attached.
The tourism calendar says to come early to get your spot. Anyone who wants to march or enter a float is told to email the city for details.
The same tourism guide also lists the Town of Ponce Inlet parade on December 5 and the City of Daytona Beach parade on Saturday night, December 12.

Holly Hill sits just north of Daytona Beach along US 1, and the parade follows that corridor north from 5th Street to City Hall at 1065 Ridgewood Avenue. Because the listing says both sides of the highway shut down, parking on side streets and walking to the curb is the practical plan.
The parade theme for 2026 is Holly Jolly Hollydays. The city clerk's page for the 67th annual parade carries the participation details and a downloadable flyer.
faq: When is the Holly Hill parade?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 10 AM to noon.
Does it cost anything?
No, the tourism calendar lists the parade as free.
Where does it go?
It begins on Ridgewood Avenue (US 1) at 5th Street, goes north and ends at Holly Hill City Hall.
Will roads be closed?
Yes, both sides of US 1 are closed during the parade.
What is the 2026 theme?
Holly Jolly Hollydays.
What should we bring?
The host suggests a comfortable chair or a blanket.

about: The listing names the Ponce Inlet Veterans Memorial Association as the breakfast host and the Town of Ponce Inlet as the presenter. The listing's price line says the $5 fee supports the association and Operation Changing Lives.
The listing places the breakfast at the Ponce Inlet Community Center on South Peninsula Drive and starts the free parade at 2 PM from Davies Park.
Holly Hill holds its own parade the same day, December 5, at 10 AM, per the area tourism guide.
faq: What time is Breakfast with Santa?
9 AM on Saturday, December 5, 2026, at the Ponce Inlet Community Center.
How much is breakfast?
$5, which the listing says benefits the Veterans Memorial Association and Operation Changing Lives.
Is the parade free?
Yes, the listing says free admission.
Which way does the parade go?
North along South Peninsula Drive, from Davies Park to Harbour Village Boulevard.

about: The city announced the parade in a July news post from its Parks, Culture and Recreation department. The post promises festive floats, marching groups, decorated vehicles and the sights and sounds of the season.
A local resort guide also lists a Christmas Celebration with tree lighting in downtown Panama City on Friday, December 4, the night before the parade.
The city lists no ticket for the parade. Questions about taking part go to pcr@panamacity.gov or (850) 872-3199.

Harrison Avenue is Panama City's main downtown street, and the city's own news post says the parade rolls up it from the marina. The city also reports Harrison Avenue was named a 2026 Great Place in Florida People's Choice winner.
The route finishes at Tommy Oliver Stadium. A second Bay County holiday event, Christmas at Harders Park, takes place a week later on December 12.
faq: When is the Panama City Christmas Parade?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 6 PM.
Where is it?
On Harrison Avenue, from the Downtown City Marina into Tommy Oliver Stadium.
Can my group join?
Contact Panama City Parks, Culture and Recreation by email at pcr@panamacity.gov or by phone at (850) 872-3199.
Is there a tree lighting too?
A resort guide lists a downtown tree lighting on Friday, December 4.
Where does the parade end?
At Tommy Oliver Stadium.
What else is happening in Bay County?
Christmas at Harders Park on Saturday, December 12, from 4 to 8 PM.

about: Bay County Parks and Recreation runs this annual event. The county's calendar page lists the contact number (850) 248-8730 and says the event is free and open to the public.

The county notes it will not hold its usual tree lighting at the Bay County Government Center this year because of construction in the building's rotunda, so this event is the county's main holiday gathering.
Families can write letters to Santa at a station on site, and a snow area is set up for play.
The park is at 8110 John Pitts Road in Panama City, and the county's calendar entry includes a facility page and map links. Parking details are not listed on the calendar entry.
Bay County's Panama City neighbor holds its Downtown Christmas Parade on Saturday, December 5 at 6 PM, a week before this event.
faq: When is Christmas at Harders Park?
Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 4 to 8 PM.
How does Santa arrive?
Santa is scheduled to arrive at 4:30 PM aboard the Bay County Sheriff's Office helicopter, weather permitting.
Is it free?
Yes. Food trucks sell food and refreshments.
What can kids do?
Photos with Santa, free face painting, a snow area and a station to write letters to Santa.
Where is Harders Park?
8110 John Pitts Road, Panama City, FL 32401.
Who do I call with questions?
Bay County Parks and Recreation at (850) 248-8730.

about: The St. Lucie County Fair Association describes the festival as a sparkling holiday light drive-thru with interactive Christmas fun and food, and its page shows photos of kids with Santa and a petting goat.
Treasure Coast Mom's guide lists the same fairgrounds address and notes online tickets cost $30 per car load plus a fee, while the fairgrounds charge $35 at the gate.
Closed Mondays and Tuesdays before December 16. From December 16 to 27 it is open every night.
faq: How much is the Festival of Lights?
The host lists $35 per car load. A local guide reports online tickets at $30 per car plus a fee.
When is it open?
Thanksgiving night through December 27, 2026: Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday 6 to 9 PM, Friday and Saturday 6 to 10 PM.
Is it closed any nights?
Mondays and Tuesdays are closed except daily December 16 to 27, per a local guide.
Where is it?
St. Lucie County Fairgrounds, 15601 West Midway Road, Fort Pierce.

about: The Fort Pierce Yacht Club's page gives the route as starting just north of the Fort Pierce North Bridge and heading south past the Village Green toward Harbour Isle.
Besides Causeway Park, the host lists viewing spots including Frances Langford Park and River Palm Cottages in Jensen Beach and Veterans Memorial Park and Sandsprit Park in Stuart.
A local guide credits the Marine Industries Association of the Treasure Coast and the yacht club with putting on the parade.

Boat parades on the Treasure Coast follow a rotation. A local guide lists the Martin County Christmas Boat Parade on December 5, the Vero Beach Christmas Boat Parade on December 6 and this St. Lucie County parade on December 12.
The yacht club's list of viewing spots spans three towns, so families can pick the stretch of the Indian River closest to home. Bring chairs and warm layers for the evening on the water.
faq: When is the St. Lucie County boat parade?
Saturday, December 12, 2026, at 6 PM.
Does it cost anything?
No, the host lists it as free.
Where can we watch in Fort Pierce?
Causeway Park, 2000 Seaway Dr, is on the host's viewing list.
Can we watch from Stuart?
Yes. The host lists Veterans Memorial Park and Sandsprit Park in Stuart among its viewing spots.
What other boat parades are nearby?
A local guide lists Martin County on December 5 and Vero Beach on December 6.
What time should we arrive?
The parade starts at 6 PM, so arrive earlier to find a spot at the park.

about: The parade's website calls it a treasured Martin County tradition since 1960 and names the 2026 theme as Santa's Stuart Vacation.
The site posts the date and time but no route, so check it again before the parade. The Martin County Christmas Boat Parade runs the next night, December 5, per a local guide.
Stuart Main Street's Christmas on Main and tree lighting comes first, on Friday, November 27.
The Martin County Christmas Boat Parade glides down the St. Lucie River and ends in downtown Stuart on December 5, a day after the street parade, according to a Treasure Coast guide.
Hobe Sound holds its own 40th annual Christmas Parade on December 5 at 1 PM, per the same guide, and Jensen Beach lights its tree on December 10 at 6:15 PM.
The parade site's headline calls it the 65th Annual Stuart Christmas Parade and notes the 1960 start.
faq: When is the Stuart Christmas Parade?
Friday, December 4, 2026, at 7 PM.
What is the 2026 theme?
Santa's Stuart Vacation.
How long has the parade run?
The parade site says it has been a Martin County tradition since 1960 and calls this the 65th annual.
Is the route posted?
Not on the parade site as of November 26, so check back before you go.
What else is on in Martin County that week?
A local guide lists the Martin County Christmas Boat Parade on December 5, the Hobe Sound parade on December 5 and Jensen Beach tree lighting on December 10.
Does the site list a price?
No, and parades on public streets are free to watch.

about: Stuart Main Street lists snowfall in Historic Downtown Stuart, DIY photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus, and Santa's sleigh rides.
The listing adds live holiday music and performances, festive arts and crafts, cookies, cocoa and seasonal sips, plus local eats and sweet treats. Admission is free.
The Stuart Christmas Parade follows a week later, on Friday, December 4.

Stuart Main Street holds this event the day after Thanksgiving, which makes it an early first stop for families with relatives in town. Local sweets and seasonal drinks are on offer alongside the cookies and cocoa.
Parking is not detailed on the host page, so check the Stuart Main Street site for updates on the day.

Other Martin County holiday dates from a Treasure Coast guide: Hobe Sound Farms sells Christmas trees and holds weekend activities from November 28 to December 13, and the Stuart Christmas Parade follows on December 4.
faq: When is Christmas on Main?
Friday, November 27, 2026, from 4 to 7 PM.
Where is it?
At the Riverwalk Stage in Historic Downtown Stuart.
Is it free?
Yes, Stuart Main Street lists free admission.
What do kids do?
Snowfall, photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus, sleigh rides and arts and crafts.
Is there snow?
The host lists snowfall in Historic Downtown Stuart.
Do we need tickets?
No, the host lists free admission.
Is there music?
Yes, the host lists live holiday music and performances.
What food is there?
Cookies, cocoa, seasonal sips, local eats and sweet treats.

about: The Visit Central Florida listing says Holidays on Central kicks off the season in Downtown Winter Haven with artisans, specialty food vendors and local choral groups.
The listed lineup includes Mike Harris, the Chain of Lakes Big Band and a holiday show by Elvis tribute artist Dwight Icenhower, plus food trucks and bakers.
The same day, the Chain of Lakes Christmas Boat Parade glides across Winter Haven's lakes at 6:30 PM, per The Ledger's Polk County guide.
Holidays on Central is a daytime market, so it works for families who want to see Santa before the evening events. A free photo booth is sponsored by Iceberg Home Services.
Winter Haven's Starlight Nights lighting runs from November 26 through January 7, per The Ledger, so families can return for lights after the day market.
faq: When is Holidays on Central?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 10 AM to 4 PM.
Where is it?
Central Park in Downtown Winter Haven.
What is there for kids?
A kids craft tent hosted by Heartland Church, a complimentary photo booth and free photos with Santa.
What does it cost?
The listing does not state a price.
Are there lights in Winter Haven too?
The Ledger lists Starlight Nights downtown from November 26 through January 7.
Who sponsors the photo booth?
Iceberg Home Services, per the listing.

about: The City of Winter Haven's calendar calls this month's Saturday Matinee The Polar Express and rates the film G.
The screening is in the Multipurpose Room at the Winter Haven Public Library on Avenue A NW.
The calendar entry does not state a price or a sign-up requirement, so check with the library if you plan a group visit.
Winter Haven's library address is 325 Ave A NW, and the matinee runs in the Multipurpose Room from 2 to 4 PM, a long enough window for the full film plus time to settle in.
The film follows a boy who doubts Santa exists until a magical train appears on Christmas Eve, a story many families pair with Winter Haven's other December events.
faq: When is the Polar Express matinee?
Saturday, December 19, 2026, from 2 to 4 PM.
Where is it?
Winter Haven Public Library Multipurpose Room, 325 Ave A NW.
What is it rated?
G.
Does it cost anything?
The city's calendar does not list a price.
What is the film about?
The calendar says a boy who doubts Santa exists boards a magical train on Christmas Eve.
Is it a library program?
The calendar labels it a downtown Saturday Matinee held at the library.
